**OPT-SysArch-03 complete.** Independently assessed frozen source **`77070c962a917597442c695335b8b0be6ddb56fe`**. No new physical blocker found for the two assessed prototype candidates. No files changed or native jobs run; no engineering sign-off.

**Source and native-audit correspondence**

Using the pinned `compact.py` and candidate JSONs, I regenerated both compacts **in memory**, reproducing the audited XML byte-for-byte:

| Candidate | Audited compact SHA256 |
|---|---|
| mild-donor2 | `86de95437aede7aff30d2ed7fb0757c8e0787b7ab800af0756e0acd018c67213` |
| late-disk | `cccc962a4134541f347ce1914793e515ac2ac527a32bdd76147bc9aed37b1c92` |

All **12 confirmation compacts**—two candidates × two responses × three momenta—match their respective native audit. Both retained reports record **zero ROOT overlaps/extrusions at `1e-5 mm`**, using checker revision `9873280239728ebaceb1f72387b70484a2382f5e`. Its checker hash matches the reviewed source. All five current factory library hashes match the reports. Candidate materials XML remains byte-identical to the baseline.

This establishes correspondence to the reported full native geometry check. I did not rerun that check.

**Physical changes and preserved interfaces**

- Mild changes only pixel barrel R1 from34 to32 mm and adds mirrored donor2 discs at900 mm.
- Late changes pixel barrel radii to31.5/57/96/182 mm, retaining12/22/18/30 staves; existing disc datums follow its JSON, with mirrored donor2 additions at2900 mm.
- Compared readouts, world constants, pipe and all strip-detector XML subtrees are unchanged.
- Source copies complete local stave/disc structures. Ring radii and feet follow the radial offset; local module stacks and orientations remain the baseline definitions.
- Collectors now follow their owning discs, retaining signed centre offsets **±36.7 mm**. Each end has ten collector stations.
- Rails retain their existing cross-sections and fixed **611–3134 mm** span, with **6.3 mm** slots at all ten disc datums. One additional slot removes **229.824 mm³ CFRP per end**. The cloned donor collector adds **4,155,214.9569 mm³ of its existing effective material per end**.
- Cages, flanges, global trunks, bypass and rear cells remain fixed.

**Identity and added-material checks**

Both native geometry exports contain **46,250 sensitive surfaces**, with **46,250 unique geometry IDs and unique logical identifier tuples**. Each added endcap disc contributes302 sensors. The new layer10 identity avoids the retained layer IDs; source rejects conflicting or out-of-range new IDs.

The added material is installed on the downstream portal:

- Mild: **z=±906.825 mm**, beyond the last silicon face at±905.825 mm.
- Late: **z=±2906.825 mm**, beyond the last silicon face at±2905.825 mm.

Each uses **one phi × one radial bin** and donor2’s area-weighted homogeneous slab. Retained normal budgets are approximately **0.0308203 X₀** on the negative side and **0.0309096 X₀** on the positive side. Recorded native decoration clears46,251 original slabs—sensors plus pipe—then reloads67 material keys. Maximum reported transported X₀/λ₀/mass closure residual is **1.94×10⁻⁷**.

**Qualifications to preserve**

ROOT nonintersection does not establish tolerances, installation access, connector/bend fit, cooling, service capacity or structural performance. Fixed trunks retain their reference cumulative inventory; new branch connectivity and changed traffic are not requalified.

The detailed DD4hep donor assembly and transported ACTS effective material are distinct representations. The area-budget closure applies to the effective carriers, not a recalculation of the modified physical assembly’s total mass. Ring circumference changes, added rail slots, cloned collectors and relocated aggregate map profiles require later candidate-specific material validation/remapping.

The pinned layout PNG was visually inspected and hash-verified. Its label correctly identifies native sensitive positions and omitted passive structures; it is not mechanical-clearance evidence.

No tracking-performance judgment was made.
